entities.summary: Oleydong Sithsamerchai is a professional boxer from Thailand who has competed in the Strawweight and Super flyweight divisions. He is a former WBC Strawweight World Champion, having captured the title on November 29, 2007, by defeating Eagle Kyowa, a fellow Thai boxer based in Japan.
